ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-22-2012 Off Calendar

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-15-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: S. Vantree, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288

Petitioner ZHI XIN HUANG(father) was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined. Also appearing on this matter is RUI LIAN HE (mother of minor child) MIN HUI HUANG, placed under oath and examined.
JERRY LUI, sworn and acts as a Cantonese interpreter on behalf of the petitioners.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to ZHI XIN HUANG to WILSON XIN HUANG(father) and MIN HUI HUANG to MANDY MIN HUANG(minor). The minor's mother signs the petition in open court.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court
